articles.title: Undersea cables could serve as a tsunami early warning system
articles.summary: Undersea cables, spanning over 1.5 million kilometers globally, are increasingly recognized for their multifaceted utility beyond mere data transmission. These critical infrastructures can serve various strategic purposes, encompassing scientific research, environmental monitoring, and potential defence applications. Recognizing their diverse functions is crucial for national security and technological advancement, emphasizing their growing importance in the modern world for both civilian and strategic uses.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh pushes For higher 'Make in India' content in Rafale deal
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh met French Minister of the Armed Forces Catherine Vautrin in New Delhi, urging for increased indigenous content in upcoming Rafale fighter jet deals. This push aligns with India's 'Make in India' initiative, emphasizing self-reliance and boosting domestic defence manufacturing. Such strategic dialogues are vital for modernizing India's armed forces and strengthening international defence partnerships.

articles.title: 7 Disney Movies I Can’t Believe DON’T Have Rides
articles.summary: The Walt Disney Company consistently converts its vast intellectual property into new theme park attractions, a strategy central to its success since Disneyland opened in 1955. This ongoing focus on bringing beloved characters and stories to life as rides ensures continued innovation and expansion within their global theme park empire, promising more immersive experiences for visitors worldwide.

articles.title: India, France sign pact for manufacturing Hammer missiles, renew defence cooperation
articles.summary: India and France have renewed their 10-year defence cooperation agreement. A significant outcome is the signing of an MoU for manufacturing Hammer missiles domestically, bolstering India's self-reliance in defence production. This strategic partnership enhances India's defence capabilities and strengthens bilateral ties, reflecting a commitment to advanced military technology and joint production, crucial for national security preparedness.

articles.title: Sentinels Cup Kicks Off with a Bang!
articles.summary: The 4th Assam Rifles Sentinels Cup Football Tournament (Men & Women) 2026 began in Shillong, Meghalaya, on February 17. This event highlights sportsmanship and physical fitness within the security forces, with the Assam Rifles Women’s Team making a strong start. Such tournaments foster camaraderie and a well-rounded personality, essential qualities for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: India and France announce ‘special global strategic partnership’
articles.summary: India and France have upgraded their bilateral relationship to a "special global strategic partnership." Announced by PM Modi and President Macron, this significant move deepens collaboration across defence, space, technology, and trade. For SSB aspirants, this highlights India's growing strategic importance and robust alliances, enhancing national security and diplomatic influence on the world stage.

articles.title: OEB supports five energy projects that empower Indigenous innovation and leadership
articles.summary: The Ontario Energy Board has selected five projects in Canada that champion Indigenous innovation and leadership in the energy transition, allocating over $1.2 million. These initiatives aim to empower Indigenous communities in developing sustainable energy solutions. This reflects international efforts towards inclusive clean energy development and self-determination, highlighting global trends in environmental governance and community involvement for SSB aspirants.
